question: Two-thirds of a certain distance was covered at the speed of 15 km/h, one-fifth at the speed of 25 km/h and the rest at the speed of 50 km/h. Find the average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey (rounded off to two decimal places).
solution:
**Given:**

(2/3) × distance is covered with speed = 15 km/h

(1/5) × distance is covered with speed = 25 km/h

Rest distance at the speed of 50 km/h.

**Formula used:**

Average speed = total distance/total time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the total distance = 15 km

Time taken to cover the (2/3) of distance = {15 × (2/3)}/15 = 2/3 hrs

Time taken to cover the (1/5) of distance = {15 × (1/5)}/25 = 3/25 hrs

Time taken to cover the rest 2 km = 2/50 = 1/25 hrs

Total time taken = (2/3) + (3/25) + (1/25)

⇒ (2/3) + (4/25) = (50 + 12)/75

⇒ 62/75

Average speed = total distance/total time taken

⇒ (15 × 75)/62 = 1125/62 = 18.145 ≈ 18.15 km/h
